description: Move forward (or backward with a negative number) by N business days in Japan, skipping weekends and national holidays. Use for due dates such as "within 5 business days".

days.description: Business days to add; negative goes back

year_end_break.description: Also treat Dec 31 - Jan 3 as non-business days (common for banks and most Japanese companies). Default false.

name: add_business_days
title: Add Japanese business days
